title: Open Protocol-Governed Computing Standard
description:
A normative specification for Protocol-Governed Computing: a model of computing in which what software may construct and may execute is determined by explicit, versioned, machine-consumable declarations, and in which nothing may be constructed or executed that those declarations do not authorize.

Part of the Protocol-Governed Computing reference corpus. Cite the version DOI of the release you used, not the concept DOI.
